title: Physical AI Conference Comes to San Jose as Robotics & Autonomous AI Go Mainstream
summary: A major conference called Physical AI Expo North America will be held in San Jose on May 18-19, 2026, focused on robotics, autonomous systems, and real-world AI deployment. The event brings together engineers, builders, and AI pioneers in Silicon Valley to discuss the mainstreaming of physical AI technology.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing need for industry collaboration and knowledge sharing as robotics and autonomous AI systems transition from specialized applications to mainstream adoption.
why_valuable: Provides a platform for global AI innovators and robotics leaders to connect and accelerate the deployment of physical AI systems in real-world applications.
